project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase + Tailwind CSS
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and Next.js build passes
environment_constraints: No Docker needed. Build verification only via npm run build.
key_patterns: Client-side components use 'use client' directive. Supabase client created via createBrowserClient with NEXT_PUBLIC env vars (anon key, no auth). Pages use .select() with embedded joins like sectors(name). Fallback logic was added in previous commits when joins fail.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js app router pages (employees, dashboard, absences, etc.). supabase/ - SQL schema and seed files. src/lib/supabase/ - client utilities.
